description: This Java source file defines the abstract factory class DelegatorFactory within the org.apache.ofbiz.entity package. It provides static methods to obtain Delegator instances by name, managing concurrency and initialization details. The class includes a nested Callable implementation, DelegatorConfigurable, which creates and configures Delegator objects asynchronously, setting up entity event handling and cache clearing.

classes.name: DelegatorFactory
classes.description: An abstract class providing static factory methods for obtaining Delegator instances, managing concurrent creation and initialization processes.

classes.name: DelegatorConfigurable
classes.description: A nested static class implementing Callable<Delegator>, responsible for creating and initializing Delegator objects asynchronously based on a given delegator name.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves a Delegator instance by name, waiting for the future to complete. Returns null if an exception occurs.

methods.name: getDelegatorFuture
methods.description: Returns a Future<Delegator> for the specified delegator name, creating and submitting a new task if necessary.
